description: REQ-018 makes the installed strict Phase 1c workflow impossible: it requires state to remain at 1b until both adversary review and later human approval pass, while the atomic workflow must transition 1b to 1c before recording the adversary gate. PROP-010 and the final review checklist repeat the incompatible requirement that no 1c verdict exist. Correct REQ-018, PROP-010, and the final checklist so Phase 1c means currentPhase=1c with an adversary verdict recorded, sprintCount=0, draft contract unapproved, humanApproved=false, and no transition to 2a.

evidence.snippet: Until a fresh artifact-only Phase 1c review and explicit strict-mode human/orchestrator approval pass, the VCSDD state shall remain at Phase 1b.
